# QUICK ACTION GUIDE - Fix All Docker Images & Repos

## ⚡ Execute Now (Choose Your Option)

### Option 1: Windows PowerShell (Simplest)
```powershell
cd C:\tmp\ChimeraIIOS
.\fix-all-docker-images.ps1
```

**That's it!** Script will:
- Clone/update all 13 repos ✓
- Fix all line endings ✓
- Rebuild 39 Docker images ✓
- Push to Docker Hub ✓
- Update all GitHub repos ✓

### Option 2: WSL2 Bash
```bash
cd ~/ChimeraIIOS
bash fix-all-docker-images.sh
```

### Option 3: Custom Users
```bash
bash fix-all-docker-images.sh YOUR_GITHUB_USER YOUR_DOCKER_USER
```

---

| Step | Time |
|------|------|
| Initialize | 1-2 min |
| Clone/Update repos | 5-10 min |

| Rebuild images | 30-90 min |
| Push to Docker Hub | 15-30 min |

| **TOTAL** | **1-3 hours** |

---

## 📊 What Happens

```
BEFORE (Error):
docker run chimeraiios bash
→ /usr/bin/env: 'bash\r': No such file or directory ✗

AFTER (Fixed):
docker run amerhwitat/chimeraiios:v1.0.0-fixed bash
→ Works perfectly! ✓
```

---

## 🎯 The Fix

**Issue**: CRLF line endings in Dockerfiles and scripts
**Solution**: Convert CRLF → LF, rebuild images, push

### Files Fixed
- ✓ 13 cloned/updated repositories
- ✓ All `.sh` shell scripts
- ✓ All `Dockerfile*` files
- ✓ All `entrypoint*` scripts

### Images Created
- **39 Docker images** (13 repos × 3 tags)
- Tags: `latest`, `v1.0.0-fixed`, `stable`
- Pushed to Docker Hub

### Repositories Updated
- **13 GitHub repos** with fixes committed and pushed
- Commit message explains all changes

---

## 📂 Build Output

After execution, you'll have:

```
docker-fix-complete/
├── repos/                    # 13 fixed repositories
├── output/                   # Build artifacts
├── docker-fix.log            # Bash build log
├── docker-fix-ps1.log        # PowerShell log
└── DOCKER_FIX_REPORT.txt    # Comprehensive report
```

## ✅ Verify It Worked

### 1. Pull a Fixed Image
```bash
docker pull amerhwitat/chimeraiios:v1.0.0-fixed
```

### 2. Run Container (Should Work!)
```bash
docker run -it amerhwitat/chimeraiios:v1.0.0-fixed bash
# No more "bash\r" errors!
```

### 3. Check GitHub
```bash
git clone https://github.com/amerhwitat/ChimeraIIOS.git
cd ChimeraIIOS
git log -1
# Should show: "Fix CRLF/LF line ending issues..."
```

---

## ⚠️ Troubleshooting

| Problem | Solution |
|---------|----------|
| Docker not found | Install Docker Desktop |
| Git not found | `apt-get install git` |
| Docker Hub login fails | Run `docker login` manually |
| Out of disk space | Run `docker system prune -a` |
| Permission denied | `chmod +x fix-all-docker-images.sh` |
